working_title: Noah's Ark and the Flood Begins: Genesis 5-7 Bible Story (KJV)

hook.text: What if obeying God meant building alone, while the whole world laughed? Genesis five to seven. Watch what most people miss: God himself shut the door.

close.text: Noah obeyed before one drop of rain fell. So here is my honest question: what are you waiting to see, before you trust God?

segments.text: What if obeying God meant building alone, while the whole world laughed? Genesis five to seven. Watch what most people miss: God himself shut the door.

The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them. I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; For it repenteth me that I have made them.
And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark,
For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights;
Noah obeyed before one drop of rain fell. So here is my honest question: what are you waiting to see, before you trust God?
